title: SpaceTraders

panels.title: Value gained in the last hour

targets.expr: (max(spacetraders_agent_credits{namespace="spacetraders"}) + (sum(max by (ship) (spacetraders_ship_value_credits{namespace="spacetraders"})) or vector(0)) + (sum(max by (ship, good) (spacetraders_ship_cargo_units{namespace="spacetraders"}) * on (good) group_left () avg by (good) (spacetraders_market_sell_price{namespace="spacetraders"})) or vector(0))) - (max(spacetraders_agent_credits{namespace="spacetraders"} offset 1h) + (sum(max by (ship) (spacetraders_ship_value_credits{namespace="spacetraders"} offset 1h)) or vector(0)) + (sum(max by (ship, good) (spacetraders_ship_cargo_units{namespace="spacetraders"} offset 1h) * on (good) group_left () avg by (good) (spacetraders_market_sell_price{namespace="spacetraders"} offset 1h)) or vector(0)))

panels.description: Total value now minus total value an hour ago: credits, plus what was paid for the ships and their equipment, plus the cargo at the average price markets pay. Buying cargo or a ship turns credits into value, so it no longer shows as a dip followed by a spike an hour later. Below zero means value was lost: fuel, or cargo bought above the average price.

panels.title: Total value

targets.expr: sum(max by (ship, good) (spacetraders_ship_cargo_units{namespace="spacetraders"}) * on (good) group_left () avg by (good) (spacetraders_market_sell_price{namespace="spacetraders"})) or vector(0)

panels.description: Stacked: the top line is the total value. Ships and equipment count at what was paid for them (starting ships at 0); cargo at the average sell price over the markets seen. A purchase moves value between bands and leaves the top line about level.

panels.title: Earned per hour, by source
panels.description: By ledger category: TradeSell, ContractDeposit, ContractPayout.

panels.title: Spent per hour, by category
panels.description: By ledger category: FuelPurchase, TradeBuy, ShipPurchase.

panels.title: Fleet

targets.expr: max by (ship, role, state, goal, reason) (time() - spacetraders_ship_status_since_timestamp_seconds{namespace="spacetraders"})

panels.description: Where: the waypoint and its type; while travelling, an arrow and where the ship goes. Doing: what the bot has it do: its goal in a few words, else its contract work (mining at the contract's source, delivering at its destination, on the way between them), else idle, or blocked with the reason. Arrives in: while travelling. Cargo and capacity: units in the hold and what it takes. Mined: units extracted in the dashboard's time range. Goal is the goal's kind, else the assignment (Contract), else None. Time in state counts from the bot's start at the latest.

panels.title: Roles
panels.description: The role board (SpaceTraders slice 6.9, switch Automation.Plan.Roles.Enabled): each ship's role, why it has it, and what each role it could take would earn it per hour by the board's estimate (its best trip, after fuel, with the production chains' share). Why: only_role (one role whose plan is on), survey_first (it surveys, as the ship with the least to lose), contract (the contract wants ore), most_profitable (what earns the fleet most per hour), no_work (none of its roles had a trip; it keeps its role), no_role. A new role takes effect when the ship's trip ends. An empty cell: the ship can't take that role, or its plan is off. With the board off, "No data": the bot exports the roles only while the plans follow them. Each change is a RoleChanged line in the journal.

panels.description: Units of each good in each ship's hold, now.

panels.description: Surveys in the cache per asteroid, used yet or not. A pile of unused ones means the miners can't keep up with the surveyor.

panels.title: Extractions per hour, with and without a survey

panels.description: Every survey taken (deposits, size, expiry) and every survey that ended, why, and after how many extractions. Open a line for its properties: Signature, WaypointSymbol, Extractions.

panels.title: Settings

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (setting, current, description) (spacetraders_setting_info{namespace="spacetraders", setting!~"Runtime[.].*", current=~"true|false"}), "order", "1 $1", "setting", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (setting, current, description) (spacetraders_setting_info{namespace="spacetraders", setting!~"Runtime[.].*", current!~"true|false"}), "order", "2 $1", "setting", "(.*)")

panels.description: Every setting the bot has, with its value now and what it does. The switches (true or false) come first, on in green; then the other settings by name. A value that may hold a secret shows (hidden), as in the journal. Left out: the Runtime.* status flags, which aren't settings to tune. What a setting does is what the running version says. Change a setting on the bot's own dashboard (Settings) or with PUT /settings/{key}; the blue "Setting changes" annotations mark when each changed. The bot samples its settings every 10 seconds, and Prometheus scrapes it every minute.

panels.title: Log lines per hour
panels.description: Budget: 5,000 lines a day per ship, the dashed line (about 208 an hour a ship). The alert compares the last 24 hours with the ships averaged over them. Loki's 31 days on 10Gi are shared with every app.

panels.title: Journal
panels.description: One line per meaningful thing (JournalEvents): contracts, purchases and sales, plans, idle and blocked ships, setting changes, resets and anomalies. Open a line for its properties.

panels.title: Errors

targets.expr: {namespace="spacetraders"} |~ `"@l":"(?:Error|Fatal)"|^[^{].*(?i:error)` | json message="[\"@m\"]" | line_format `{{ if .message }}{{ .message }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}`

panels.description: What the "SpaceTraders logged errors" alert counts: the bot's lines at level Error or Fatal, and lines from nginx or the init container containing "error". Warnings that repeat raise the RepeatingError anomaly instead. Open a line for its properties.
